RepositoryList.note: Three rows in a bordered card: folder glyph leading, text-heading title over a muted description, chevron trailing, border-border-light dividers with the last row's divider suppressed.

WithTrailingStatus.note: Four environment rows with success/info/destructive/neutral Badges in the trailing slot — all four badge tones read clearly on the card surface.

WithAvatarLeading.note: UserAvatar monograms in the leading slot sized by the row's size-8 box; role Badges trailing. Shows the leading slot taking a non-icon child.

TitleOnlyAndDisabled.note: Title-only, title+description+trailing, and a disabled row at reduced opacity — three distinct slot combinations in one card, including the disabled state.
